_comment_purpose: hybrid-live retrieval config for Claude Desktop — BM25 (FTS5) + TF-IDF + ML embeddings fused via RRF, BGE reranking, HNSW, PDFs, and live watch.
_comment_setup: Template only: prefer `enquire-mcp configure --tier hybrid-live --client claude-desktop`, which pins the current Node + enquire entry paths automatically. If editing this file manually, replace `/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/enquire-mcp` with the same durable executable path used for all preflight commands: `/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/enquire-mcp setup --vault '/ABS/PATH/TO/Obsidian Vault' --include-pdfs`; `/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/enquire-mcp install-model rerank-bge`; `/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/enquire-mcp doctor --tier hybrid-live --vault '/ABS/PATH/TO/Obsidian Vault'`. A package spec alone is insufficient because npx resolution can vary by working directory.
_comment_flags: Flags explained: --persistent-index = BM25 via SQLite FTS5; --enable-reranker = BGE cross-encoder on top of RRF (+15.5 NDCG@10 / +24.7 MRR measured on the reproducible 60-query ablation, ~30-50ms latency); --use-hnsw = sub-10ms semantic top-K, persisted to disk after first build (v2.16+); --include-pdfs = blend PDF chunks into hybrid search with [page: N] citation markers (requires pdfjs-dist optionalDependency); --watch = incremental rebuild on .md changes so you don't restart after editing in Obsidian.
